title: Unordered Packet Sequence Restoration
description: A satellite network card receives data packets out of order. Each packet contains an integer sequence number. Given an unsorted integer array packets representing all received sequence numbers, find the length of the longest consecutive sequence of numbers present in the array. You must design an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.
output_format: Return an integer representing the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.

examples.explanation: The longest consecutive elements sequence is [1, 2, 3, 4]. Its length is 4.
The longest consecutive sequence is [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], which has length 9.
The array has a single element sequence [10], which has length 1.
